failure.cause: the harness passed the per-fit metrics mapping (fit_key -> {split: metrics}) to a helper written to consume {split: metrics} entries; the science helper was verified by unit tests but the post-fit aggregation call path was not exercised by any zero-fit test before the freeze
failure.classification: harness/accounting defect, not a scientific or environment failure
failure.stage: post-fit harness accounting, after all 12 fits had completed
failure.why_not_recovered: Issue #77 forbids any second science invocation and any science retry after the first optimizer step; a fix-and-rerun would also reuse already-attempted fits, which the #76 adjudication rejected

fits.plan: 12 frozen attempts (2 parametric primaries, 2 parametric verification repeats, 6 neural primaries, 2 neural seed-0 verification repeats)

structural_remedy_evidence.note: the 12 fits were executed and durably recorded, so a faithful completion of this replication would require reusing these already-attempted fits rather than running 13+ attempts; the harness cannot currently do that because it evaluates constraints in-process
structural_remedy_evidence.proposed_direction_for_reviewer_only: a successor or amendment that (a) treats the durable ledger as the attempt record and (b) evaluates constraints/metrics in a zero-fit accounting path over persisted per-fit predictions; no design change is required and no science rerun is needed
